company.name: Nebius
company.shortDescription: Nebius is a cloud platform designed for artificial intelligence development, training, and inference.
company.description: Nebius provides infrastructure that scales from individual units to large clusters, using a range of NVIDIA graphics processing accelerators and networking components. Its services include managed Kubernetes environments, orchestration tools, and storage solutions tailored for demanding machine learning workloads. The entity supports diverse applications, from generative design and molecular discovery to large language model optimization. By managing data centers and hardware configurations, the group enables researchers and engineers to deploy complex models without maintaining physical server environments. These resources enable the creation of digital art, music generation, and pharmaceutical research through automated workflows.
